entities.summary: Laos is a sovereign nation in Southeast Asia, Asia. Its capital is Vientiane. Official languages include Lao. Government: Unitary Marxist-Leninist one-party socialist republic. Population: approximately 7.7 million. Area: 236,800 km². Comprehensive index for Laos covering Austroasiatic/Tai migrations, Lan Xang kingdom (1353-1707, million elephants), split into three kingdoms, Siamese suzerainty, French Indochina 1893, Japanese occupation, independence 1953, civil war/Secret War (US bombing 1964-1973, most bombed country per capita), Pathet Lao victory 1975, communist single-party state, Mekong development, and gradual economic opening.
